How your data is handled ↗Format JSON without rounding large numbers ↗

Good to know

Does it decode plus signs as spaces?

No. It follows decodeURIComponent, where + remains a plus sign. Form-encoded query strings may use different rules.

Do I need to create an account?

No. All Toolnest tools work without an account. There are no paid features in this version.
